description: Set a prayer's status to active, waiting, answered or ongoing, with an optional note recording what happened. Requires the prayer id from read_prayers or save_prayer. Returns the updated prayer.

note.description: Optional short reflection recorded with the update, e.g. what happened and when.

prayer_id.description: UUID of the prayer, from read_prayers or save_prayer.

status.description: New status. answered records that the prayer was answered; waiting and ongoing mark it as still open.

name: update_prayer_status
title: Update prayer status
